landing.heroBody: SALEEM checks your ad or post before you publish and tells you where the problem is, to the second — why it matters, and how to fix it.
landing.demoHint: Pick a marker on the timeline
landing.demo1Title: Ad without disclosure before it starts
landing.demo1Fix: Open with “paid ad” and add #ad to the caption.
landing.demo2Fix: Remove weight promises; describe your own experience.
landing.demo3Fix: Say the code is part of a paid partnership.
landing.how1Body: A clip up to 90 seconds, an image or text — with the caption and post details.
landing.how2Body: It analyzes Saudi-dialect speech, visuals and caption against a rulebook with published sources.
landing.how3Body: Each issue comes with its timestamp, source and a suggested fix. Re-check, then keep the compliance log.
landing.whoCreatorsBody: A quick mobile check before Snapchat, TikTok and Instagram.
landing.whoAgenciesBody: Track checks across creators and campaigns in one place.
landing.whoBrandsBody: Make sure your ads disclose clearly and avoid risky claims.
landing.whoMediaBody: A consistent first pass before editorial and legal review.
landing.checksMawthooq: Mawthooq ad terms: disclosure, contract and licensing.
landing.checksContent: Media content rules: children, privacy and language.
landing.checksAi: Disclosure of AI-generated or AI-edited content.
landing.checksCommerce: Misleading health and financial ad claims.
landing.trustAdvisoryBody: SALEEM helps you comply; it never grants official approval. The final decision is yours.
landing.trustPrivacyBody: We never send your content to anyone, and we delete media after 24 hours.
landing.trustSourcesBody: Every issue links to a rule and its source, and the full rulebook is open.
landing.trustLimitsBody: AI can be wrong. Issues with weak evidence are shown as warnings, not violations.
